# Lando 3 kitchen-sink fixture corpus

These two files are a Lando 3 Landofile inventory and a Lando 3 global-config
inventory. They were assembled by surveying real Lando 3 project files and by
tracing Lando 3 core 3.26.x source, then condensed into single kitchen-sink
YAML documents for parser and compatibility tests.

Lando 3 is distributed under GPL-3.0-only. GPL-3.0-only terms govern any
portions of this corpus that are derived from Lando 3.

These files are test fixtures only. They are not published in the `@lando/sdk`
npm package; that package's `files` field is limited to `src` and `dist`.

This notice is the repository's reviewed statement for this corpus. There is
no separate fixture-license policy document. It restates license terms for
attribution and compliance tracking and does not draw any further legal
conclusion.
